title: Chapter 78: The Alliance'S Elite Forces Take Charge Of The Attack
content:
Chapter 78: The Alliance'S Elite Forces Take Charge Of The Attack

The Alliance army rushed to the huge transport team guarded by the Bugbear army and stopped.

This time, the Zerg puppies did not rush directly.

"Finally arrived!"

"Sure enough, this transport team is big enough!"

"If it is destroyed, they will be heartbroken for a while!"

"Hahaha!"

"However, there are so many Bugbears guarding here, and there are priests sitting in charge. Maybe we can't defeat them!"

Meng came to the front of the battle and looked at this huge team. He was happy and worried.

After the Alliance army was divided into two routes, there were not even 10,000 troops in the main attack direction.

The Bugbears blessed by the priests are not easy to mess with. If they go berserk, it will be even more difficult to deal with.

"Let's go around behind them first. Their task is to guard the transported materials and they dare not easily launch an active attack!"

Wu Qing rode over on a warhorse.

The dog in front of the Alliance Army began to bypass the transport team guarded by the Bugbear Army. The Bugbear Army, which was on high alert, did not intercept them.

The Bugbear Army was now confused about the situation on the battlefield. They were afraid that the army in front of them was a bait, tempting them to take the initiative and then attack the transport team they were guarding.

With this concern, they did not dare to take risks.

Both sides were secretly on guard and passed each other peacefully. The Alliance Army smoothly moved to the south side of the huge transport team guarded by the Bugbear Army.

A cavalry of the Bugbear Army has been moving with the Alliance Army, always keeping between the transport team and the Alliance Army, and the Bugbear infantry is also constantly deploying troops and adjusting the formation.

The long transport team is more dangerous on the side. The transfer of the Alliance Army is separated by a sufficient distance. If the distance between the two sides is too close, the Bugbear Army will definitely take the initiative to launch an attack just in case.

"The enemy has set up a long snake formation. Is the position now almost the same?"

"How about we cut him off in the middle?"

Meng followed Wu Qing and began to rub his hands.

"We have too few troops. Let's concentrate our strength to destroy the enemy's manpower first!"

Wu Qing rejected Meng's proposal.

If it is really necessary to destroy the enemy's combat supplies at all costs, then Meng's suggestion is very good. Now is the best time to attack.

But this is not Wu Qing's goal. Wu Qing wants to destroy as many of the enemy's manpower as possible. The Zerg needs resources to increase its troops.

The Alliance army continued to advance rapidly until it came to the southern rear section of the long transport team on the avenue, and then stopped far away.

The bear goblin army thought that the Alliance troops would leave directly to escape. After all, this is the territory of the evil god camp, and the evil god army is deployed around to block it.

They didn't expect that this small army would suddenly stop leaving, and it seemed that they wanted to attack the transport team.

The Alliance army did not launch a surprise attack, but stuck in the range of the long-range attack of the Alliance elite troops and began to line up calmly.

The puppies were scattered on both sides, with 5,000 elites of the Alliance in the middle and 1,000 elites of the same type in a small square.

This clearly meant that they were going to fight the Bugbear Army.

There were always Zerg puppies lurking around, and the Bugbear Army's scouts could not be sent out at all, and they knew nothing about the surrounding situation.

So although the Bugbear Army had a large number of troops, the area they had to protect was also huge.

The Alliance Army was so calm in its formation that anyone would worry about a conspiracy.

But such an enemy army was placed in an uncomfortable position, and its threat was real, and it could not be ignored.

The Bugbear Army had to dispatch nearly 10,000 Bugbear Infantry and Cavalry, which was equivalent to the number of the Alliance Army, and placed them in front of the Alliance Army.

This was the result Wu Qing wanted to see!

"How is it? There is not much time left. Do you have the confidence to quickly defeat the enemy in front of the formation?"

Wu Qing asked Meng.

The main force of this battle was replaced by 5,000 elite troops of the Alliance. They replaced the position of the Zerg Hydralisk, and the puppies assisted them.

"No problem! Of course I have confidence!"

"However, after this battle, except for Yu Chong and his team, the long-range combat capabilities of others will be useless!"

"Is there any impact?"

Meng looked at Wu Qing.

"It doesn't matter, you fight as much as you want!"

"After this battle, you can retreat!"

Wu Qing knew that normal armies could not be compared with the Zerg. The elite troops of the Alliance were led by him to run around and fight continuously. Until now, they can still fight another big battle, which can already show their elite status.

If it were an ordinary army, they would have been tossed down by him long ago.

"Okay! You just watch our performance here!"

Meng rode a giant tiger and rushed to the front of the 5,000 elite troops of the Alliance, coming to the middle of Yu Chong and Bai Yan.

"Brothers!"

"Kill the group of lunatics in front!"

"Do you have confidence!?"

Meng opened his tiger roar, and the momentum was deafening!

"Yes!"

"Yes!"

"Yes!"

The 5,000 elite troops of the Alliance shouted in unison three times, and their morale reached its peak.

"Everyone, get ready! Fire in unison!"

Meng showed off his superb throwing skills on the back of the giant tiger, and was the first to throw an excellent javelin to the rear of the bear goblin army.

Bai Yan, who was next to him, was not to be outdone, and also threw a javelin in a beautiful posture.

Yu Chong was different. He drew his bow and aimed at a prominent and important person in the enemy's formation. He was an accurate shooter.

Behind them, there were javelins, arrows and hand axes flying out in unison.

The soldiers of the bear goblin tribe, whether because they are confident in their own physical fitness or because they need to be ready to go berserk at any time, they do not carry shields.

Facing the overwhelming long-range attacks, they can only wave the big sticks in their hands to resist, or rely on their equipment and their own physical fitness to bear it.

As the representative race of the evil god camp in this area, the comprehensive strength of the bear goblin soldiers is still very strong. The long-range attack effect of the elite troops of the alliance is obviously much worse than that of the previous battle.

However, the effect is still very obvious. The dense phalanx of the bear goblin army has become much sparser.

The strength of the 5,000 elite troops of the alliance is strong, and their long-range combat weapons are specially made and their range is very long.

The long-range stone throwing attack of the bear goblin army can't reach the phalanx of the alliance army at all.

Facing the second volley of the Alliance's elite troops, the passive bear goblin army could only choose to charge!

Behind them were important combat supplies for transportation, and they could not retreat.

The second volley of the Alliance's elite troops once again knocked down and killed a large number of bear goblin infantry and cavalry.

At this time, the bear goblin cavalry had already started to charge, and the bear goblin infantry followed closely behind and rushed towards the Alliance army.

The third volley of the Alliance's elite troops arrived as expected, and more bear goblin soldiers disappeared in light.

"Free fire!"

"Don't save weapons!"

"After this battle, we will go home!"

Meng ordered the free fire order.

After three volleys, the soldiers of the bear goblin army had already scattered, and the relative density of personnel was not as good as before. If they fired again, the killing efficiency would be lower.

And free shooting, high-speed precision shooters like the Feather Clan Horse Archers, can play a greater role.
